roads.name: Cotton Hill Road
words: Sweeping and steady: 15 curves in 3.6 miles.
From 355 to 473 ft, with 386 ft of up and down along the way.
roads.ratingNote: Bars show where it sits among the region's roads; the numbers are each part's share of the rating. At the 55 mph limit its corners still ask for about 0.75 g, so the curves, not the limit, set the pace. Most of it has no posted limit on the map, so this assumes 55 mph.

roads.name: County Road 69
words: Properly twisty: 12 curves in 2.2 miles, about 6 a mile.
Plenty of tight curves among them.
From 472 to 587 ft, with 258 ft of up and down along the way.
roads.ratingNote: Bars show where it sits among the region's roads; the numbers are each part's share of the rating. At the 55 mph limit its corners still ask for about 1.45 g, so the curves, not the limit, set the pace. Most of it has no posted limit on the map, so this assumes 55 mph.
